_about: Player controls (lane CTRL, build v68), read by ControlsTable.cs. scheme 'swipe' = Infinity-Blade style while locked on: LMB / pad RB with no slide = stab, slide left / right at or just before the press = that slash, slide up = overhead; release before attack.holdHeavyMs = light, hold = heavy (charged while held). RMB / Q / pad LB = guard, the slide (mouse) or right stick picks the guard side. Lock off: the mouse turns the camera and attacks use the classic WASD + click rules. scheme 'classic' = the old WASD + click scheme everywhere. enabled false or no file = the exact old behaviour (classic, guard blocks every side). Defaults from Frankendom V3 (18 px slide, 50 deg up cone, 220 ms heavy, 100 ms heavy grace) and V1 (combat 4 m / sticky 6 m / ends 12 m for 3 s, camera ease in 3/s out 1.8/s).

mouse._about: axisToPx converts Input.GetAxisRaw('Mouse X'/'Mouse Y') to pixels (InputManager mouse sensitivity is 0.1, so 1 axis unit = 10 px). flickWindowMs = how long before the press a slide still counts (the slide is summed from press - flickWindowMs to the moment the move is decided). deadZonePx = slide shorter than this = no direction (stab / centre guard). guardClampPx = the guard cursor (slide summed since the guard press) is clamped to this length so a flick the other way switches side quickly.

pad._about: Gamepad (old Input Manager). stickX / stickY = Input Manager axis names of the right stick; they are NOT in ProjectSettings yet: run Tools > Controls > Add Right Stick Axes once (Editor/ControlsInputAxes.cs). A missing axis disables the stick (one warning). deadZone 0..1. The attack direction is the strongest stick sample inside the flick window. guardLatch true = the guard side stays after the stick springs back. Keys are KeyCode names: RB = JoystickButton5, LB = JoystickButton4, Y = JoystickButton3, X = JoystickButton2 (A / B / R3 are dodge / riposte / lock elsewhere). Specials go on Y / X because LB + RB are guard + attack and the D-pad is an axis in the old Input Manager.

attack._about: strikeFire 'release' = the light fires when the button is released before holdHeavyMs (the heavy fires at holdHeavyMs and charges while held); 'down' = the light fires on press with the pre-press slide and turns into the heavy of the same direction at holdHeavyMs (inside cancel.json holdToHeavyUntilTick). heavyGraceMs = after the heavy fired, a new slide inside this time re-aims it (only while still in the wind-up). useCounterHeavyHold true = while the foe is in a wind-up the hold threshold is heavyHoldMsInCounterWindow (V1 option). sectors = screen directions of the slide, deg 0 = up, +90 = right, the first sector (file order) whose |angle - deg| <= halfWidthDeg wins; no slide = noSlideDir. map = direction -> move ids, the first id that exists in the MoveTable is used (missing ones are animation gaps, see MANIFEST).

guard._about: guardRequiresSide true = Duel.Resolve only counts a block / parry when the defender's guard side covers the swing; classicRequiresSide false = a human who is not swiping right now (scheme classic, or lock off) still blocks every side as before (the AI, the balance bot and a swiping human always need the side) (the parry window numbers are untouched, parry.json / stamina.json). sides = guard sides by slide angle (same convention as attack.sectors), id = DuelFighter.guardSide (1 left, 2 right, 3 top -> guard_left / guard_right / guard_up poses; add low / straight later with new ids). centreName / centreAliases = no side (guardSide 0). deadBandDeg = hysteresis: the side only changes when the new side is matched with halfWidthDeg - deadBandDeg. snap 'latch' = the side stays until another side is slid to; 'live' = a slide back inside the dead zone returns to centre. match = attack direction (MoveDef.direction, attacker frame) -> guard sides that cover it (defender frame, mirrored: the attacker's right cut meets the defender's LEFT guard); '*' = any guard; a direction with no row = any guard. Block ease: the required side counts when it was held at contact or inside the last sideGraceMs (+ heavyBlockWindowBonusMs for a heavy swing, Duel's heavy = charges or damage >= 18) + the blockEase row of the class.

camera._about: combatCamera 'locked' = combat auto-enters the lock view (enemy alive within enterRange m, or the duel start when lockAtDuelStart) and auto-leaves it (enemy dead, or farther than exitRange for exitSeconds; inside stickyRange the timer resets). Tab still toggles by hand; a manual unlock holds until the next combat start. 'free' = no auto lock, Tab only (today). easeIn / easeOut = CameraRig lock blend per second (was 3 both ways).

marker._about: On-screen direction marker (OnGUI, DirectionalInput). anchor 'crosshair' = screen centre, 'player' = above the player (yOffset m). Attack: a square offset distPx toward the pending direction (stab = on the centre) while the strike is held; guard: a bar on the held side; idle: the direction a press now would take (showIdle). Colours RGBA 0..1.

bot._about: FlowBot (balance bot) guard side: when it raises a guard / parry against a swing, sideReadChance = it picks the side that covers the swing, else a wrong side. AIBrain keeps its own read skill (ai profile 'read').

touch._about: HCAUDIT1 v104: TouchControls (phone) layout. centreX/centreY = STRIKE centre as a screen fraction (y up); radiusFrac x min(w,h) = one button radius; *R values are in button radii; buttons = ring around STRIKE (deg, label, action = DuelFighter.Press id or guard=hold); colours r,g,b,a.

touchRelease._about: HCKIT4 v95: keys whose HOLD hands the player back to the keyboard after a touch (PlayerBrain: TouchControls.Active stays on until a real key is pressed). Key names = UnityEngine.KeyCode. Per-action rebinding is laneREBIND (settings.json keys); this list is the stock set (move, run-roll, guard, strike).

bindings._about: Rebindable keys (lane REBIND, v100), read by InputMap.cs. Each action: keys = keyboard / mouse defaults (one entry per slot, 'slots' slots are shown; the player's changes live in settings.json 'keys', only for actions that differ), pad = gamepad buttons the map itself reads (fixed), padFrom = a controls.json pad list shown as the gamepad column (DirectionalInput reads those), padText = free text for sticks, overlap = actions that may share a key without a conflict warning (the arrow keys move AND pick the guard side). reserved = keys that cannot be assigned (menu / system keys). moveAxisX / moveAxisY = the Input Manager axes the default move keys + left stick come through. fixedRows = keys that are not rebindable, listed in the Controls tab. These rows SUPERSEDE the key lists in dodge.json input.rollKeys, flow.json lockOn.keys / riposte.keys, stances.json input.nextKeys / prevKeys, hud.json hint.toggleKey while this block is enabled (the old lists are the fallback when it is off or an action is missing). enabled false or no block = the old hard-coded keys.

actions.label: Move forward
actions.hint: Walk or run away from the camera. The arrow keys also pick the guard side.

actions.label: Move left
actions.hint: Double-tap while locked on = side-step (the first key is the one that counts).

actions.label: Strike
actions.hint: Tap = light attack, hold = heavy. Slide the mouse (or the right stick) while you press to pick the direction.

actions.label: Heavy attack
actions.hint: A heavy swing at once, without holding Strike.

actions.label: Guard
actions.hint: Hold to block. Tap just before a blow lands to parry.

actions.label: Guard side: left
actions.hint: Pick the guard side with a key (the mouse slide or the right stick does the same).

actions.label: Dodge
actions.hint: Roll, side-step or back-step by the direction you hold.

actions.label: Next stance
actions.hint: The mouse wheel and the D-pad also switch stance.

actions.label: Controls panel
actions.hint: Shows or hides the in-game key list.
